title: P2 incident.dismiss: request
description: Body of P2 incident.dismiss: only a principal of kind human with incident.manage in the tenant of the incident can declare an incident false, only with a reason code from a closed list and with a "Details" text that the person typed; without them the denial dismiss_reason_required (MGR-8). The core writes the code and the text into the incident record and the audit and does not pass them into model context.

reason_code.description: Reason code. The core checks that the code and the text are present, answering dismiss_reason_required.
